title: Add Airtable-style calendar view component
body:
## Implementation Plan: Airtable Calendar Component

- [x] Create calendar view UI component (month/week/day grid)
- [x] Create event item component for displaying records as calendar events
- [x] Implement calendar renderer component that integrates with ComponentRegistry
- [x] Add calendar view to complex renderers
- [x] Export calendar renderer from index
- [x] Test the calendar component with sample data
- [x] Verify build process works
- [x] Create documentation/example
- [x] Address code review feedback
- [x] Address PR review comments (JSDoc and property redundancy)

## Summary

Successfully implemented an Airtable-style calendar component for Object UI with the following features:

### Features Implemented
✅ **Three View Modes**: Month, Week, and Day views with smooth switching
✅ **Flexible Data Mapping**: Configure field names for title, dates, and colors
✅ **Color Coding**: Support for custom color mappings based on event types
✅ **Interactive Navigation**: Previous/Next buttons and "Today" quick navigation
✅ **Event Display**: Smart event rendering with time display for non-all-day events
✅ **Multi-day Events**: Properly displays events spanning multiple days
✅ **Responsive Design**: Tailwind CSS styling with full customization support
✅ **JSDoc Documentation**: All field mappings documented for auto-generation

### Components Created
- `CalendarView` UI component (`packages/components/src/ui/calendar-view.tsx`)
- `calendar-view` renderer (`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/calendar-view.tsx`)
- Documentation (`docs/components/calendar-view.md`)
- Playground example with sample data

### Recent Changes
- Added JSDoc comments to field name mappings per Rule #3 (Schema First Mindset)
- Removed redundant `defaultView` property, using only `view` for clarity
- Updated property labels and descriptions for better documentation

### Screenshot

![Calendar View](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1f2f6cc2-9af2-4562-89e9-f7ffece77c68)

### Usage Example

```json
{
  "type": "calendar-view",
  "view": "month",
  "colorField": "type",
  "colorMapping": {
    "meeting": "#3b82f6",
    "deadline": "#ef4444",
    "event": "#10b981"
  },
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "title": "Team Meeting",
      "start": "2026-01-13T10:00:00.000Z",
      "type": "meeting"
    }
  ]
}
```
